svg.title: Vendor AI contract data-rights review
svg.desc: A vendor contract excerpt showing data use, retention, subcontractor, audit, and opt-out clauses.
svg.text: Question target: spot vague clauses before uploading customer or employee data.

g.text: 4.1 Customer may upload operational records, transcripts, emails, and survey data.
4.2 Vendor may use uploaded data to improve services and model performance.
4.3 Data will be retained for the term of service plus a reasonable operational period.
4.4 Vendor may use approved subprocessors listed on request.
4.5 Customer may request deletion subject to backup and legal limitations.
4.6 Audit report available under NDA, frequency not specified.
The clause does not clearly separate processing, training, retention, deletion, or subprocessor approval.
